mechanism_narrative: Accelerating GDP growth, as measured by the year-over-year change in real GDP, signals a strengthening economy that will boost corporate earnings and drive positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: Y-o-y GDPC1 growth accelerates by > 2pp but SPX 60-day forward returns are negative in > 40% of instances.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp drop in the unemployment rate below 4% signals a tightening labor market that will drive wage inflation, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days as the Fed tightens policy.
failure_condition: UNRATE drops below 4% but SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in > 60% of triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp drop in industrial production, as measured by the year-over-year change in INDPRO, signals a supply shock that will drive inflation and negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: Y-o-y INDPRO growth drops by > 3pp but SPX 60-day forward returns are positive in > 40% of instances.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp rise in the federal funds rate above 5% signals a tightening monetary policy that will drive negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: FEDFUNDS rises above 5% but SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in > 60% of triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: When the housing starts series HOUST rises by more than 10% year-over-year and the unemployment rate UNRATE is below 5%, it signals a strong consumer demand environment that will drive positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: HOUST y-o-y growth > 10% and UNRATE < 5% but SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in > 40% of instances.

mechanism_narrative: When the unemployment rate UNRATE rises by more than 0.5 percentage points in 3 months and payroll employment PAYEMS declines month-over-month, it signals a weakening labor market that will drive negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: UNRATE rises > 0.5pp in 3mo and PAYEMS declines m-o-m but SPX 60-day forward returns are positive in > 40% of instances.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp rise in the consumer price index CPIAUCSL above 3% year-over-year signals high inflation that will drive the Fed to tighten monetary policy, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: CPIAUCSL y-o-y growth rises above 3% but SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in > 60% of triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: When real GDP GDPC1 declines quarter-over-quarter and the federal funds rate FEDFUNDS is above 4%, it signals a recessionary environment that will drive negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: Q-o-q GDPC1 decline and FEDFUNDS > 4% but SPX 60-day forward returns are positive in > 40% of instances.
